name: postzen-linkedin
description: Twelve Claude skills that run a LinkedIn account, with publishing and scheduling to your personal profile through the PostZen MCP server: posts off 21 hook formulas, comments, replies, profile score, weekly plan, DMs, inbox triage, PDF carousels, repurposing, audits, a humanizer that strips the AI fingerprint, and a publish skill that verifies the post went out. Nothing is posted until you say yes.
